qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil filler pipe on the 3HP-22 transmission?
What torque should I use for the oil filler pipe on 4HP-22/4HP-24/A5S 310Z transmissions?
What is the screw size and torque specification for the plug component 9AZ?
What are the two different torque values for oil bore plugs depending on transmission type?
qa_pairs.answer: 8 Nm for A5S 300J and 15 Nm for A5S 310Z/A5S 560Z

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the damper cover on transmission case for A5S 300J?
What screw size and torque should I use for the radial shaft seal on converter bell housing?
What is the torque specification for the intermediate plate on intermediate housing?
Which transmission types use the radial shaft seal specification for A4S 270R/A4S 310R?

qa_pairs.answer: Section 24-4 Automatic Transmission, specifically subsection 24 11 Transmission Case, Oil Sump
